definitions.setsStrict: first run: some expected finding of the reference set (author or blind key) or devset-b changes status
definitions.oldUnit: first run: a test of the earlier unit suites fails (text pins excluded); these tests assert on the template text
definitions.semantic: a semantic-rules test that passes unmutated fails under the mutant (tests failing under the whitespace control excluded: none do)
definitions.semanticLoud: semantic kill where every failing test shows the compile or the query failing (role-name guard, type error), not a wrong finding set
definitions.setsOrSemantic: behavioural kill: setsStrict or semantic (excludes the text-asserting unit tests)
definitions.equivalent: killed neither by a set nor by a semantic test, and classified equivalent by reading the template (EQUIVALENT in scripts/v1.3/rule-mutation.ts); a text-asserting unit test may still fail on it
definitions.behaviouralSurvivorsNonEquivalent: neither setsStrict nor semantic, and not classified equivalent
